features.title: Amber scaffold install (init)
features.user_visible_behavior: A project gains AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, feature_list.json, and a wiki skeleton, with existing files preserved (idempotent).
verification: node scripts/amber.js init --target <repo> is idempotent and skips existing files
evidence: npm test: 1158/0 passing across Node 18/20/22 CI matrix
notes: Self-dogfooded: amber init runs against this repo's own layout.

features.title: Doctor validation
features.user_visible_behavior: amber doctor reports whether a repo's Amber setup is usable and internally consistent.

features.title: Route engine
features.user_visible_behavior: Routes (feature-standard, bugfix-quick, refactor-safe) can be listed, inspected, validated, and dry-run tested; session goals auto-match via goalPattern.

features.title: Session lifecycle
features.user_visible_behavior: Sessions can be started, listed, status-checked, aborted, and continued from checkpoints.
notes: Test-suite leak guard (run-tests.js) prevents root .amber/sessions accumulation.

features.title: Governance report & approval gates
features.user_visible_behavior: amber governance report scores the delivery loop and emits structured next actions; gates enforce human approval before completion.

features.title: Handoff reports
features.user_visible_behavior: amber handoff produces a portable handoff bundle for clean session continuity.

features.title: Governed loop execution (ADR-0003)
features.user_visible_behavior: Loop contracts run only behind four gates: policy rules, explicit one-shot approval, isolated worktree, and a tamper-evident ledger.
evidence: readyForLiveScheduling=false by product boundary; human-triggered --execute only
notes: No autonomous or scheduled execution; cron/daemon and auto-approval disallowed.

features.title: Web viewer (Phase C)
features.user_visible_behavior: A Vite + React + tRPC viewer renders sessions, timelines, ledgers, and governance state.
notes: Owns its TS toolchain; excluded from root eslint.
